title.narrative: Supporting the wheat production chain in the eastern Aleppo countryside

description.narrative: Rehabilitation of irrigation and drainage networks and water pumping stations to ensure efficient water supply, reduce salinity, and improve soil fertility across 2,750 hectares in the Al-Safira area. 2. Increasing the availability of high-quality improved seeds in the local market by supporting wheat seed multiplication centers. This includes rehabilitating a seed storage warehouse with a capacity of 8,000 tons and providing a mobile sifting machine to ensure the center's ability to meet the needs of local farmers. 3. Strengthening the capacities of three agricultural extension units in the region by providing them with machinery. Agricultural and cadre training, ensuring that farmers receive technical support during the planting season."

This project relies on an integrated intervention to support the wheat production chain from planting to harvest. This is achieved through the rehabilitation of agricultural infrastructure, including irrigation and drainage networks and water pumping stations, contributing to the availability of improved wheat seeds in the local market, enhancing agricultural extension services, and providing agricultural mechanization. The project targets 2,750 rural families within a single geographic area covering 2,750 hectares.
To enhance food security and provide livelihoods in the eastern countryside of Aleppo Governorate, in addition to supporting the sustainability of wheat production chains.
